chunks: Sa‘d ibn ‘Abdallah narrated from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn ‘Isa, from al-Hasan ibn ‘Ali ibn Faddal, from ‘Abdallah Bukayr, from some of our companions, from Abi ‘Abdallah (عليه السلام), that he heard him say:

When Amīr al-Mu’minīn (عليه السلام) was taken, al-Hasan and al-Husayn and two other men carried him out, until, when they had gone out from al-Kufah, they left it on their right. Then they proceeded through al-Jabbānah until they passed with him to al-Gharī, where they buried him, leveled his grave, and then departed.

key_terms.أَمِيرُ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ: Title of Imam ‘Alī (عليه السلام), meaning Commander of the Faithful
key_terms.الْجَبَّانَةِ: The graveyard tract or open burial ground route they traversed
key_terms.الْغَرِيِّ: The location where Amīr al-Mu’minīn (عليه السلام) was buried
key_terms.الْكُوفَةِ: The city from which they departed with his body
key_terms.قَبْرَهُ: His grave, which they leveled after burial

ai.seo_question: How was Amīr al-Mu’minīn ‘Alī (عليه السلام) buried after his death according to al-Kāfī?
ai.summary: This hadith reports the burial of Amīr al-Mu’minīn (عليه السلام) after his passing, describing how al-Hasan and al-Husayn, along with two other men, carried him out from al-Kufah to al-Gharī and buried him there. It preserves an early historical account connected to the burial place of Imam ‘Alī (عليه السلام) and reflects the care taken in concealing and smoothing over the grave.

en.sarwar: 11. Sa‘d ibn ‘Abdallah has narrated from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn ‘Isa from al-Hassan ibn Ali ibn Faddal from ‘Abdallah ibn Bukaayr from certain persons of our people who has said the following. “He heard abu ‘Abdallah (a.s.) say, ‘

When Amir al-Mu’minin Ali (a.s.) died, al-Hassan and al-Husayn and two other man carried his body out until they went out of Kufa. They continued with Kufa on their right and then they moved forwards on the path of Jabana until they passed al-Ghari. They then buried him and leveelled his grave and then return (home).”
